verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change is correct and complete within the diff's scope. Refused non-printable trigger summaries remain excluded from the published document, are reported without echoing attacker-controlled content, and use an independently bounded drop-log seam so field failures cannot consume row or evidence warning budgets. The revised three-value helper contract has no stale callers. The self-tests cover quiet accept paths, truncation versus refusal, stripped/code-point counts, log-forgery resistance, cap and total behavior, seam independence, retained rows, and the guard ordering that prevents duplicate diagnostics; their expected values and flood sizes are test-side literals rather than values derived from production constants. No trust check, workflow permission, or security route is weakened.
